title: Find the full names and T-shirt sizes of members who attended any 'Meeting'
question: Find the full names and T-shirt sizes of members who attended any 'Meeting' event in 2020, wear a medium or large T-shirt, and have generated income greater than $30. Order the results by last name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m."XCL_035",
    m."XCL_036",
    m."XCL_039"
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m."XCL_034" = a."XCL_002"
JOIN event AS e ON a."XCL_001" = e."XCL_010"
JOIN income AS i ON m."XCL_034" = i."XCL_029"
WHERE e."XCL_013" = 'Meeting'
  AND e."XCL_012" LIKE '2020%'
  AND m."XCL_039" IN ('Medium', 'Large')
  AND i."XCL_026" > 30
ORDER BY m."XCL_036"
